#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int MAXN = 1000007;
ll P, K;
ll visited[MAXN];
ll cnt[MAXN];

ll calc(int len) {
    ll base = (cnt[len] * len) % MOD;
    base = (base + 1) % MOD;
    ll res = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= cnt[len]; i++)
        res = (res * base) % MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> P >> K;
    memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
    memset(cnt, 0, sizeof(cnt));
    if (K == 0) {
        ll ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++)
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        cout << ans << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (K == 1) {
        ll ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++)
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        cout << ans << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            ll len = 0;
            ll cur = i;
            while (!visited[cur]) {
                visited[cur] = 1;
                len++;
                cur = (K * cur) % P;
            }
            cnt[len]++;
        }
    }
    ll ans = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < P; i++) {
        if (cnt[i]) {
            ans = (ans * calc(i)) % MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
